scenario:
An enterprise-level cryptocurrency trading platform is being developed to facilitate advanced trading strategies, analytics, and performance tracking for perpetual futures contracts. The platform caters to professional traders and institutional investors, providing tools to optimize trading performance, evaluate risk, and track returns on investment.

The system will manage a wide range of cryptocurrency pairs, each with real-time data on popularity among traders, return on investment (ROI), and profit and loss (PnL). It will capture the duration of trading positions, offering insights into strategy duration and market direction.

The trading platform must support robust analytics capabilities, including historical data analysis, trend prediction, and strategy backtesting. Advanced user management is required to handle different roles, such as traders, analysts, and administrators, with specific permissions for trading actions, data access, and reporting.

Additionally, the platform will include a social trading feature, allowing users to copy popular trading strategies and share insights within the community. This requires a comprehensive tracking system for strategy popularity and performance metrics. The system will also need to integrate with various exchanges to provide seamless trading experiences and data synchronization.
